EXE-04.sql:
WITH outcomes AS (
 SELECT 'plan_type' AS dimension,s.plan_type AS segment,e.completion_pct FROM enrollments e JOIN students s USING(student_id)
 UNION ALL SELECT 'acquisition_source',s.acquisition_source,e.completion_pct FROM enrollments e JOIN students s USING(student_id)
 UNION ALL SELECT 'city',s.city,e.completion_pct FROM enrollments e JOIN students s USING(student_id)
 UNION ALL SELECT 'category',c.category,e.completion_pct FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c USING(course_id)
 UNION ALL SELECT 'level',c.level,e.completion_pct FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c USING(course_id)
), rates AS (SELECT dimension,segment,ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE completion_pct = 100) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS completion_rate_pct FROM outcomes GROUP BY 1,2)
 SELECT dimension,MIN(completion_rate_pct) AS lowest_completion_pct,MAX(completion_rate_pct) AS highest_completion_pct,MAX(completion_rate_pct)-MIN(completion_rate_pct) AS gap_pp FROM rates GROUP BY dimension ORDER BY gap_pp DESC,dimension;

CAT-01.sql:
WITH course_perf AS (
 SELECT c.course_id,c.title,c.category,c.level,c.status,c.instructor_id,c.price_idr,
        c.duration_hours,c.avg_rating,c.created_date,
        COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS enrollments,COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS learners,
        COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100) AS completed_enrollments,
        ROUND(AVG(e.completion_pct),2) AS avg_completion_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.enrollment_id),0),2) AS completion_rate_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.certificate_issued)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.enrollment_id),0),2) AS certification_rate_pct,
        c.price_idr::bigint*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS potential_booking_value_idr
 FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e USING(course_id)
 GROUP BY c.course_id,c.title,c.category,c.level,c.status,c.instructor_id,c.price_idr,c.duration_hours,c.avg_rating,c.created_date
) SELECT course_id,title,enrollments FROM course_perf WHERE status='published' ORDER BY enrollments DESC,course_id LIMIT 10;

COH-06.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(last_accessed) AS as_of_date FROM enrollments) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',e.enrolled_date)::date AS enrollment_cohort,a.as_of_date,COUNT(*) AS enrollments,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct<100 AND a.as_of_date-e.last_accessed>90) AS at_risk_enrollments,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct<100 AND a.as_of_date-e.last_accessed>90)/COUNT(*),2) AS at_risk_rate_pct FROM enrollments e CROSS JOIN anchor a GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

RSK-01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS enrollments,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE completion_pct<25) AS low_completion_enrollments,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE completion_pct<25)/COUNT(*),2) AS low_completion_rate_pct FROM enrollments;

RSK-02.sql: SELECT c.course_id,c.title,COUNT(*) AS partially_completed_enrollments FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c USING(course_id) WHERE e.completion_pct>0 AND e.completion_pct<100 GROUP BY c.course_id,c.title ORDER BY partially_completed_enrollments DESC,c.course_id;

RSK-03.sql:
WITH segment_perf AS (
 SELECT s.acquisition_source,s.plan_type,COUNT(*) AS enrollments,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) AS learners,
        ROUND(AVG(e.completion_pct),2) AS avg_completion_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100)/COUNT(*),2) AS completion_rate_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.certificate_issued)/COUNT(*),2) AS certification_rate_pct
 FROM enrollments e JOIN students s USING(student_id)
 GROUP BY s.acquisition_source,s.plan_type
) SELECT acquisition_source,plan_type,enrollments,learners,avg_completion_pct,completion_rate_pct FROM segment_perf WHERE enrollments>=30 ORDER BY completion_rate_pct,acquisition_source,plan_type;

RSK-04.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(last_accessed) AS as_of_date FROM enrollments) SELECT a.as_of_date,(e.completion_pct<100 AND a.as_of_date-e.last_accessed>90) AS at_risk_proxy,COUNT(*) AS enrollments,COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS learners,ROUND(AVG(e.completion_pct),2) AS avg_completion_pct FROM enrollments e CROSS JOIN anchor a GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY at_risk_proxy DESC;

RSK-05.sql: WITH anchor AS (SELECT MAX(last_accessed) AS as_of_date FROM enrollments) SELECT c.course_id,c.title,s.acquisition_source,s.plan_type,COUNT(*) AS at_risk_enrollments FROM enrollments e JOIN students s USING(student_id) JOIN courses c USING(course_id) CROSS JOIN anchor a WHERE e.completion_pct<100 AND a.as_of_date-e.last_accessed>90 GROUP BY c.course_id,c.title,s.acquisition_source,s.plan_type ORDER BY at_risk_enrollments DESC,c.course_id,s.acquisition_source,s.plan_type LIMIT 100;

STR-01.sql:
WITH course_perf AS (
 SELECT c.course_id,c.title,c.category,c.level,c.status,c.instructor_id,c.price_idr,
        c.duration_hours,c.avg_rating,c.created_date,
        COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS enrollments,COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS learners,
        COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100) AS completed_enrollments,
        ROUND(AVG(e.completion_pct),2) AS avg_completion_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.enrollment_id),0),2) AS completion_rate_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.certificate_issued)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.enrollment_id),0),2) AS certification_rate_pct,
        c.price_idr::bigint*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS potential_booking_value_idr
 FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e USING(course_id)
 GROUP BY c.course_id,c.title,c.category,c.level,c.status,c.instructor_id,c.price_idr,c.duration_hours,c.avg_rating,c.created_date
) SELECT category,SUM(enrollments) AS enrollments,ROUND(100.0*SUM(completed_enrollments)/NULLIF(SUM(enrollments),0),2) AS completion_rate_pct,SUM(potential_booking_value_idr) AS potential_booking_value_idr FROM course_perf WHERE status='published' GROUP BY category ORDER BY completion_rate_pct DESC,enrollments DESC,category;

        c.price_idr::bigint*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS potential_booking_value_idr
 FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e USING(course_id)
 GROUP BY c.course_id,c.title,c.category,c.level,c.status,c.instructor_id,c.price_idr,c.duration_hours,c.avg_rating,c.created_date
) SELECT course_id,title,enrollments,avg_rating,completion_rate_pct FROM course_perf WHERE status='published' AND enrollments>(SELECT AVG(enrollments) FROM course_perf WHERE status='published') AND (completion_rate_pct<(SELECT AVG(completion_rate_pct) FROM course_perf WHERE status='published') OR avg_rating<(SELECT AVG(avg_rating) FROM course_perf WHERE status='published')) ORDER BY enrollments DESC,course_id;

STR-03.sql:
WITH segment_perf AS (
 SELECT s.acquisition_source,s.plan_type,COUNT(*) AS enrollments,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) AS learners,
        ROUND(AVG(e.completion_pct),2) AS avg_completion_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100)/COUNT(*),2) AS completion_rate_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.certificate_issued)/COUNT(*),2) AS certification_rate_pct
 FROM enrollments e JOIN students s USING(student_id)
 GROUP BY s.acquisition_source,s.plan_type
) SELECT acquisition_source,plan_type,enrollments,completion_rate_pct,certification_rate_pct,CASE WHEN completion_rate_pct>=(SELECT AVG(completion_rate_pct) FROM segment_perf) THEN 'acquisition candidate' ELSE 'retention support' END AS recommendation FROM segment_perf WHERE enrollments>=30 ORDER BY acquisition_source,plan_type;

WITH course_perf AS (
 SELECT c.course_id,c.title,c.category,c.level,c.status,c.instructor_id,c.price_idr,
        c.duration_hours,c.avg_rating,c.created_date,
        COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS enrollments,COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS learners,
        COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100) AS completed_enrollments,
        ROUND(AVG(e.completion_pct),2) AS avg_completion_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.enrollment_id),0),2) AS completion_rate_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.certificate_issued)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.enrollment_id),0),2) AS certification_rate_pct,
        c.price_idr::bigint*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS potential_booking_value_idr
 FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e USING(course_id)
 GROUP BY c.course_id,c.title,c.category,c.level,c.status,c.instructor_id,c.price_idr,c.duration_hours,c.avg_rating,c.created_date
), instructor_perf AS (
 SELECT i.instructor_id,i.name,i.expertise,i.avg_rating,COUNT(c.course_id) AS courses,
        COALESCE(SUM(c.enrollments),0) AS enrollments,
        ROUND(100.0*SUM(c.completed_enrollments)/NULLIF(SUM(c.enrollments),0),2) AS completion_rate_pct
 FROM instructors i LEFT JOIN course_perf c USING(instructor_id)
 GROUP BY i.instructor_id,i.name,i.expertise,i.avg_rating
) SELECT instructor_id,name,expertise,avg_rating,enrollments,completion_rate_pct FROM instructor_perf WHERE avg_rating>=(SELECT AVG(avg_rating) FROM instructor_perf) AND completion_rate_pct>=(SELECT AVG(completion_rate_pct) FROM instructor_perf) ORDER BY enrollments DESC,instructor_id;

STR-06.sql:
WITH course_perf AS (
 SELECT c.course_id,c.title,c.category,c.level,c.status,c.instructor_id,c.price_idr,
        c.duration_hours,c.avg_rating,c.created_date,
        COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS enrollments,COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS learners,
        COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100) AS completed_enrollments,
        ROUND(AVG(e.completion_pct),2) AS avg_completion_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.completion_pct=100)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.enrollment_id),0),2) AS completion_rate_pct,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) FILTER(WHERE e.certificate_issued)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.enrollment_id),0),2) AS certification_rate_pct,
        c.price_idr::bigint*COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS potential_booking_value_idr
 FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e USING(course_id)
 GROUP BY c.course_id,c.title,c.category,c.level,c.status,c.instructor_id,c.price_idr,c.duration_hours,c.avg_rating,c.created_date
), ranked AS (
 SELECT course_id,title,enrollments,completion_rate_pct,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY enrollments DESC,course_id) AS demand_rank,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY completion_rate_pct,course_id) AS completion_rank FROM course_perf WHERE status='published' AND enrollments>0
), action_evidence AS (
 SELECT 1 AS priority,'Improve completion' AS action,title AS target,enrollments AS affected_enrollments FROM ranked WHERE completion_rank=1
 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'Review high-demand content',title,enrollments FROM ranked WHERE demand_rank=1
 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'Re-engage inactive enrollments','Incomplete; last access >90 days before dataset anchor',COUNT(*) FROM enrollments CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(last_accessed) AS as_of_date FROM enrollments) a WHERE completion_pct<100 AND a.as_of_date-last_accessed>90
) SELECT priority,action,target,affected_enrollments FROM action_evidence ORDER BY priority;
